Name: Franklyn Fowler
Quirks: speaks with the slow deliberate weight of a very old man who has earned his authority
the hawk nickname is earned - he misses nothing
Dorne's patience as strength is not ideology for him but lived experience
CharacterDescription: Franklyn Fowler called the Old Hawk is the Lord of Skyreach and head of House Fowler, holding the mountain passes of the Red Mountains between Dorne and the Reach. He is old, perhaps seventy, Lord of Skyreach for decades, also Warden of the Prince's Pass. He has been lord long enough to have outlasted multiple kings and crises. He has the patience of the mountains he guards and the hawkish sharpness of his nickname. He watches the current chaos in the north with the detached attention of a man who has seen chaos before and learned that Dorne tends to survive it.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Franklyn Fowler, called the Old Hawk, is the Lord of Skyreach and the head of House Fowler. He also holds the title Warden of the Prince's Pass. He is the father of the Fowler twins.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Skyreach two days before Ned Stark's execution. Watching the realm from his mountain passes.
